schema.description: Map of system_id (as string) to SystemStats.

StatsResponse.description: Stats summary keyed by system ID (as string). When the `id` query parameter is provided the map contains a single entry whose key is that ID.

BoundaryMetering.description: Which components fall inside the metering boundary for the system. Field types reflect the upstream API: most are tri-state booleans (`true`/`false`/`null`), `hydraulic_separation` is a free-text label.

SystemMeta.description:
System metadata. Field set verified against /system/list/public.json (103 distinct fields across 742 public systems on 2026-05-07). The /system/get.json variant is a subset that omits `heatpump_elec_feedid`, `heatpump_heat_feedid`, `heatpump_elec_ago`, `heatpump_heat_ago`, `heatpump_max_age`, `heatpump_model_id`, `heatpump_url`, `manufacturer_id`, and `photo_count`.

Many fields are stored as form values upstream and round-trip as strings even when they hold numeric data. Boolean-style toggles are returned as integer 0/1.

dhw_coil_hex_area.description: DHW coil heat exchanger area (m²). Numeric string.

heat_demand.description: Annual space heat demand (kWh). Numeric string.

heatpump_elec_ago.description: Seconds since the last electrical feed sample. /list only.

heatpump_elec_feedid.description: Feed ID for electrical input. Returned as `false` for unauthenticated requests. /list only.

heatpump_heat_ago.description: Seconds since the last heat feed sample. /list only.

heatpump_heat_feedid.description: Feed ID for heat output. Returned as `false` for unauthenticated requests. /list only.

heatpump_max_age.description: Threshold (seconds) used to decide whether the system is considered up-to-date. /list only.

installation_Cost.description: Note the capitalised 'C' as returned by the upstream API.

kwh_m2.description: Annual demand per m² (kWh/m²). Numeric string.

photo_count.description: Number of photos as numeric string. Present only in /system/list/public.json.

water_heat_demand.description: Annual DHW heat demand (kWh). Numeric string.

wc_curve.description: Weather compensation curve setting. Numeric string.

SystemStats.description:
Stats summary for one system over a window. Field set verified against /system/stats/last90 and /system/stats/monthly on 2026-05-07.

* The `last7`/`last30`/`last90`/`last365`/`all`/custom-window endpoints return numeric fields as JSON numbers.
* `/system/stats/monthly` returns numeric fields as JSON strings (numeric strings).
* `timestamp` may also be the boolean `false` for systems that have never been scored.

The schema accepts both representations. Dynamic per-tariff `unit_rate_*` fields are absorbed by `additionalProperties: true`.

from_energy_feeds_elec_kwh.description: Electrical energy from cumulative kWh feeds rather than power integration.

quality_elec.description: Coverage / data-quality indicator for the electrical signal in this window.

timestamp.description: Unix epoch seconds. For /system/stats/monthly this is the start-of-month timestamp; for some systems it is `false`.

unit_rate_agile.description: Octopus Agile mean unit rate over the window (£/kWh).

unit_rate_cosy.description: Octopus Cosy mean unit rate over the window (£/kWh).

unit_rate_go.description: Octopus Go mean unit rate over the window (£/kWh).

weighted_time_on.description: Seconds the heat pump was running, weighted.

weighted_time_total.description: Total weighted seconds in the window.

config_cache.description: Internal cache marker. Treat as opaque.

feeds.description: Map of feed name to feed descriptor.

start_date.description: Earliest sample timestamp across all feeds (unix epoch seconds).

TimeseriesFeed.description: Metadata for a single feed. `unit` is omitted for feeds whose unit is not configured upstream.

unit.description: Engineering unit (e.g. W, kWh, C). May be absent.

sessionCookie.description: Session cookie established by logging in via the web UI at /user/login. Required only for /system/list/user.json. Cookie name is implementation-specific to the upstream PHP application; verify against your captured Set-Cookie header.
sessionCookie.name: PHPSESSID

info.description:
Unofficial OpenAPI specification for the HeatpumpMonitor.org public API. Compiled from https://heatpumpmonitor.org/api-helper and verified empirically against the live API on 2026-05-07. HeatpumpMonitor.org is part of the OpenEnergyMonitor project (https://openenergymonitor.org).

Upstream serialization quirks captured in this spec:
  * Many SystemMeta fields are stored as form values and round-trip as strings even when they hold numeric data (e.g. `kwh_m2`, `heat_demand`, `dhw_target_temperature`, `weighted_*`).
  * `/system/stats/monthly` stringifies every numeric field; the other stats endpoints return raw numbers. SystemStats numeric fields therefore accept both `number` and `string` representations.
  * `timestamp` in stats responses can be `false` when the system has never been scored.
  * Boolean-style toggles (e.g. `UFH`, `mid_metering`, `metering_inc_*`, `published`, `volumiser`) are returned as integer 0/1.
  * Schemas use `additionalProperties: true` so dynamic / per-tariff fields (e.g. new `unit_rate_*` keys) do not fail validation.
info.title: HeatpumpMonitor.org API

get.description:
Returns timeseries data for a given system. Response is a JSON object keyed by feed name; each value is an array of `[timestamp_ms, value]` pairs (timestamp is unix epoch in milliseconds; value is a number, possibly null).

Requesting a feed name that does not exist on the system causes the upstream PHP backend to inline a warning into the response body (HTTP 200 but invalid JSON). Always call /timeseries/available first to discover valid feed names.
